title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Revised & Perfected Mock 02
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Safety Management Plan (SMP) guidelines, 'safety communication with regulators' primarily involves:
options: Regular reporting of safety performance indicators and proactive statutory engagement
Seeking prior permission for every daily shift deployment
Submitting daily production logs to the Regional Inspector
Annual auditing of financial expenditure on safety equipment
questions.solution: Safety communication in SMP involves regular reporting of leading/lagging safety indicators and proactive engagement with DGMS.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The systematic hierarchy followed during an incident investigation in mines includes analyzing:
options: Only direct financial losses and equipment damage
Only the unsafe act performed by the primary operator
Immediate cause, contributing factors, and root underlying causes
Eyewitness statements and worker attendance records only
questions.solution: Comprehensive incident investigation follows the hierarchy: Immediate cause -> Contributing factors -> Systemic/Root causes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017, what is the minimum quantity of usable air required per person employed underground in any ventilation district?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 153 mandates at least 6.0 m³/min per person employed in the largest shift, or 2.5 m³/tonne daily output, whichever is larger.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Environmental and personal exposure monitoring under Mines Rules & DGMS circulars covers:
options: Ambient air temperature and barometric pressure only
Inhalable dust, toxic/inflammable gases, noise, and microclimate temperature
Barometric pressure, illumination, and vibration levels only
questions.solution: Workplace monitoring mandates assessing airborne dust, toxic/inflammable gases, noise exposure, and microclimate conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, shot-firing in underground coal mines during shift hours can only be performed when:
options: All non-essential persons are withdrawn to a safe location outside the blast danger zone
The Mine Manager is physically present at the working face
Ventilation fans are temporarily turned off to prevent smoke spread
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 191 requires withdrawing all persons from the danger zone (at least 150m radius or safe shelter) prior to firing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, a 'Rescue Board' is established to oversee and manage:
options: Only opencast mine disaster management teams
Rescue stations and rescue work across a specified zone/subsidiary
First-aid training centers in mining colleges
questions.solution: Mines Rescue Rules 1985 specify the constitution of a Rescue Board to manage rescue stations and organize rescue services.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which of the following represents a combination of Leading and Lagging safety performance indicators?
options: Production output and equipment diesel consumption
Safety training hours conducted and Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
Fatal accident rate and total overburden excavated
Number of haul trucks deployed and daily rainfall logs
questions.solution: Safety training hours (proactive/leading) and LTIFR (retrospective/lagging) together form balanced safety indicators.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: If a Mining Sirdar finds that his district is so large that he cannot make the required statutory inspections, the matter shall be reported to the Manager, who shall refer it to:
options: The Regional Inspector / Chief Inspector of Mines
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129: If a Sirdar's district size prevents thorough examination, the manager refers the matter to the Chief/Regional Inspector for decision.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Slurry (Water-Gel) explosives are preferred over ANFO in blast holes primarily because:
options: They are cheaper than dry ANFO
They do not generate any detonation fumes
They can be initiated without a booster charge
questions.solution: Slurry/Water-gel explosives exhibit high water resistance, making them suitable for wet blast holes where ANFO dissolves.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The recommended floor gradient in an opencast pit to ensure proper natural drainage away from the face is:
questions.solution: A pit floor gradient of 1 to 2% (1 in 100 to 1 in 50) towards sumps ensures efficient water drainage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Coal Mines Regulations, self-rescuers must be provided to:
options: Only officials above the rank of Overman
All persons entering underground coal mine workings
Only face workers operating continuous miners
questions.solution: Providing approved self-rescuers to all persons going underground in coal mines is mandatory.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Rule 77A of Mines Rules 1955, every register of accidents maintained at the mine must record:
options: Date, time, location, nature of injury, cause, affected person details, and action taken
Only accidents resulting in more than 14 days of absence
Names of witnesses and equipment serial numbers only
Financial compensation paid to injured workers only
questions.solution: Accident registers (Form J) must comprehensively detail date, time, nature of injury, cause, personnel details, and preventative measures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In the standard Hierarchy of Hazard Controls, which sequence lists measures from MOST effective to LEAST effective?
options: PPE -> Administrative Controls -> Engineering Controls -> Substitution -> Elimination
Elimination -> Substitution -> Engineering Controls -> Administrative Controls -> PPE
Administrative Controls -> Engineering Controls -> PPE -> Elimination -> Substitution
Substitution -> Elimination -> PPE -> Engineering Controls -> Administrative Controls
questions.solution: Correct hierarchy: Elimination (most effective), Substitution, Engineering Controls, Administrative Controls, PPE (least effective).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How does a high Stripping Ratio (Vol. of Overburden : Vol. of Coal) impact mine reclamation planning?
options: It eliminates the requirement for topsoil preservation
It increases the volume of overburden to be backfilled and dump area required
It allows immediate plantation without grading
It reduces the pit depth significantly
questions.solution: A higher stripping ratio means more overburden waste is generated, requiring larger dump footprints and higher backfilling effort.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Effective dust suppression systems on haul roads are critically required to prevent:
options: Excessive tire wear on dumpers only
Engine overheating in heavy earth moving machinery
Pneumoconiosis among workers and collisions due to poor visibility
Spillage of coal from dumpers during haulage
questions.solution: Haul road watering prevents respiratory diseases (silicosis/pneumoconiosis) and maintains clear line-of-sight visibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Converting a deep mined-out pit void into a water body during final reclamation serves to:
options: Create artificial water reservoirs for local groundwater recharge and eco-restoration
Store toxic mine tailings permanently without monitoring
Evaporate acidic mine drainage without treatment
questions.solution: Constructing eco-parks or reservoirs in final voids restores local hydrologic balance and creates aquatic ecosystems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary function of a detonator in blasting operations is to:
options: Produce high gas volume to push the rock face
Initiate high-order shock wave transformation in the secondary explosive
Seal the blast hole collar tightly
Dilute toxic blast fumes generated in the column
questions.solution: Detonators supply a high-velocity shock impulse to detonate cap-sensitive explosives or booster charges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Reg 164, what is the minimum danger zone radius around a blasting site in opencast mines where warnings must be sounded?
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 164 mandates establishing a danger zone radius of at least 500 meters around the blast site in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Why is higher explosive concentration (bottom charge) required at the toe section of a bench blast hole?
options: Because the toe rock experiences maximum confinement and high burden restraint
questions.solution: The toe of a bench is heavily confined by the floor rock; hence a high-density bottom charge is needed to break toe rock cleanly.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The Emergency Plan under CMR 2017 Regulation 104 must be:
options: Prepared once during project approval and stored in the manager's safe
Prepared, periodically updated, communicated to workers, and rehearsed via mock drills
Submitted only to the local district magistrate
Implemented only after an actual disaster occurs
questions.solution: Emergency Response Plans must be updated regularly, displayed clearly, and validated through periodic mock drills.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a Shot-firer in a coal mine must hold a valid Shot-firer's or Sirdar's Certificate, along with a valid:
options: Gas Testing Certificate and First Aid Certificate
questions.solution: A Shot-firer must hold a Gas Testing Certificate and First Aid Certificate along with their statutory competency certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.topic: Opencast Machinery & Heavy Earth Moving Equipment
questions.stem: In strip mining operations, 'Casting Dozer' or 'Blast Casting' techniques are used primarily to:
options: Build stable haul roads across soft ground
Move overburden directly into the adjacent mined-out pit void without loading
Level coal seam surfaces prior to continuous surface miner deployment
questions.solution: Casting techniques throw or push overburden directly into the adjacent exhausted cut, minimizing haulage costs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In underground coal mines, the primary purpose of applying Resin Capsule Roof Bolts is to:
options: Prevent gas leakage from the roof strata
Bind roof strata laminations together into a monolithic composite beam
Divert underground water away from coal faces
Replace the requirement for side pillar support
questions.solution: Roof bolting clamps laminated rock strata layers together to form a stiff, self-supporting composite beam (Beam Building Effect).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, the Canteen Management Committee must consist of equal representation from:
options: Employer/Management representatives and elected worker representatives
District Magistrate and Trade Union President
questions.solution: Mines Rules mandate a Canteen Committee with equal numbers of management nominees and worker representatives.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Afforestation on overburden dumps using leguminous plant species helps in:
options: Biological nitrogen fixation and soil stabilization against erosion
Increasing soil acidity to prevent weed growth
Absorbing explosive gas fumes from nearby blasts
questions.solution: Leguminous species fix atmospheric nitrogen into the soil and build root networks that arrest dump slope erosion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under DGMS guidelines, the minimum height of safety berms constructed along the edge of opencast haul roads must be:
options: Equal to the radius of the largest dumper wheel
Not less than the height of the largest dumper tire
At least 0.5 meters, regardless of truck size
Equal to the height of the dumper cabin
questions.solution: DGMS circulars specify safety berm heights along haul roads/dump edges must not be less than the tire height of the largest vehicle.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Section 22 of the Mines Act 1952, an Inspector of Mines may issue an order prohibiting employment in a mine if:
options: The mine fails to achieve monthly production targets
There exists an urgent and immediate danger to the safety of workers
The manager fails to submit financial reports on time
questions.solution: Section 22 empowers inspectors to prohibit work/employment if conditions present imminent danger to human safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In blasting terminology, a 'Cut' hole pattern in underground face driving is designed to:
options: Create an initial additional free face for subsequent relief holes
Reduce noise and ground vibration levels
Cut electrical cables safely prior to firing
questions.solution: Cut holes (e.g., wedge cut, burn cut) extract an initial cavity, providing a second free face for remaining face holes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In HEMM operations, 'Spotting' a dumper at a loading shovel face refers to:
options: Inspecting the dumper for mechanical oil leaks
Guiding and positioning the dumper accurately in the shovel loading zone
Parking the dumper during shift changeover
Measuring dumper payload weight using sensors
questions.solution: Spotting involves positioning the dumper safely at the correct angle under the shovel bucket for efficient loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The process of separate stripping, stockpiling, and re-spreading of topsoil in opencast mining is essential to:
options: Preserve biological soil seed banks and organic fertility for post-mining revegetation
Prevent spontaneous combustion in overburden dumps
questions.solution: Selective topsoil handling preserves native microbes, nutrients, and seed banks required for rapid bio-reclamation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017 Regulation 64, statutory mine working plans must be updated by the Surveyor at least once in every:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64 mandates that statutory mine plans and sections be posted up to date at least once every three months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under DGMS noise exposure standards, what is the maximum permissible continuous noise level for an 8-hour shift work period?
questions.solution: DGMS circulars prescribe 85 dB(A) as the 8-hour Time Weighted Average (TWA) permissible exposure limit.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the Sirdar's daily inspection report entry made at the end of a shift must be recorded in:
options: A bound paged book kept at the mine for the purpose
A personal pocket notebook carried home
questions.solution: CMR 2017 requires statutory reports to be recorded in bound-paged books kept at the mine office for inspection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The statutory Annual Return under the Mines Act 1952 must be submitted by the Owner/Manager to DGMS on or before:
questions.solution: Annual returns for the preceding calendar year must be submitted to the Chief Inspector on or before 20th February.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, formal extraction or depillaring plans in underground coal mines require prior written approval from:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 112 requires obtaining prior permission/approval from the Regional Inspector before depillaring/coal extraction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 136, the maximum gradient of any haul road used by dumpers in opencast mines shall not exceed:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 136 stipulates that haul road gradients shall not be steeper than 1 in 10 (10%), except on short ramps (1 in 8).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In opencast mine geometry, the term 'Highwall' refers to:
options: The unexcavated, steep wall of rock and coal at the pit edge
The sloping face of an overburden waste dump
The protective earthen bund along haul roads
The retaining wall built around sumps
questions.solution: The highwall is the unexcavated vertical or steep face exposed during opencast pit advancement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The selection of blast hole diameter in bench blasting directly influences:
options: Drilling cost, explosive charge distribution, and resulting rock fragmentation size
The chemical composition of slurry explosives
The statutory qualification required for the shot-firer
The electrical resistance of detonator lead wires
questions.solution: Hole diameter dictates burden/spacing parameters, explosive loading density, and rock fragmentation distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per CMR 2017 Regulation 29, a Safety Officer appointed in a coal mine must hold:
options: A First Class or Second Class Manager's Certificate of Competency
An Overman Certificate with no experience
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 29 specifies that Safety Officers must hold a Manager's Certificate of Competency (First/Second Class based on output).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Applying agricultural lime during topsoil rehabilitation on overburden dumps helps to:
options: Neutralize soil acidity and improve soil nutrient availability
Compact soil to prevent root growth
questions.solution: Liming treats acidic overburden/topsoil (often caused by pyrite oxidation), bringing pH to neutral levels for plant growth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Treatment of Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) generated in mine discharge water typically involves:
options: Adding sulfuric acid to precipitate iron
Neutralization with alkaline reagents (e.g., lime) followed by heavy metal settling
questions.solution: AMD treatment uses lime/alkali addition to raise pH, neutralizing acid and precipitating heavy metals in settling basins.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: How frequently must the Safety Management Plan (SMP) of a mine be formally reviewed and audited under DGMS guidelines?
options: Only when a fatal accident occurs
questions.solution: DGMS guidelines mandate an annual review and update of the mine Safety Management Plan.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which class of explosives is strictly prohibited for underground shot-firing in coal mines due to firedamp ignition hazards?
options: Permitted P1, P3, and P5 explosives
Emulsion slurry explosives approved by DGMS
questions.solution: Non-permitted commercial explosives (like raw ANFO or plain dynamites) are strictly forbidden underground due to gas/dust explosion hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While conducting pre-shift inspections in a Degree II gassy coal seam, the Mining Sirdar must carry an approved Flame Safety Lamp / Multi-gas detector and:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 specifies carrying an approved flame safety lamp/gas detector along with a CO detector in fiery/gassy seam inspections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Regular inspection of haul road shoulders, berms, and drainage channels in opencast mines is vital to prevent:
options: Dumper tipping/rollover accidents and road edge failure
Excessive fuel vaporization in haul trucks
questions.solution: Maintaining firm haul road shoulders and berms prevents heavy dumpers from breaching road edges and tipping.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.topic: Opencast Machinery & Heavy Earth Moving Equipment
questions.stem: How does operational digging action differ between a Hydraulic Face Shovel and a Hydraulic Backhoe?
options: Face shovel bucket digs away from the machine; Backhoe bucket pulls back toward the machine
Face shovel is used for soft soil only; Backhoe is used for hard rock only
Backhoe digs upward above track level; Face shovel digs downward below track level
They use identical bucket movement kinetics
questions.solution: Face shovels crowd and bucket-fill away from the cab above bench level; backhoes pull downward/inward toward the cab below bench level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Emulsion explosives offer superior operational performance in wet opencast blast holes because they:
options: Have high water resistance and high Velocity of Detonation (VOD)
Are completely immune to accidental impact initiation
Do not produce any post-blast nitrogen oxide (NOx) fumes
Can be loaded without booster charges in small diameters
questions.solution: Emulsions consist of microscopic fuel-oxidizer droplets protected by oil, offering excellent water resistance and high VOD.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Break-Even Stripping Ratio' (BESR) in opencast coal mining defines the limit where:
options: The cost of overburden removal plus coal mining equals the recoverable value of coal
Total overburden volume equals total coal tonnage mined
The cost of drilling equals the cost of blasting
Opencast mining becomes twice as expensive as underground mining
questions.solution: BESR represents the economic cutoff ratio where the total cost to extract coal via opencast equals the market value of the coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per Mines Rules 1955, a statutory Safety Committee must be constituted in every mine wherein the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Rules mandate setting up a Safety Committee in mines employing more than 100 workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In Risk Assessment terminology, 'Risk' is mathematically defined as the product of:
options: Probability/Likelihood of occurrence and Consequence/Severity of harm
Number of workers exposed and shift duration
Frequency of inspection and safety expenditure
questions.solution: Risk = Likelihood (Probability) × Consequence (Severity).

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 104, the Mine Safety Policy prepared by the Owner/Management must be:
options: Written in English, Hindi, and local vernacular, displayed prominently, and communicated to all workers
Kept strictly confidential among board directors
Submitted to DGMS without worker disclosure
questions.solution: Safety Policies must be written, translated into local languages, displayed at key mine locations, and explained to workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 78, all winding ropes, cages, safety catches, and shaft guides must be thoroughly examined by a competent person at least once in every:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 78 mandates weekly thorough examination of shaft winding ropes, cages, suspension gear, and guides.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: While inspecting opencast workings under CMR 2017 Reg 129, a Sirdar inspecting bench edges and highwalls for loose overhangs must maintain a safe distance of at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 (Opencast duties) specifies that inspecting officials shall not approach within 3m of an unstable bench edge.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: According to CMR 2017 Regulation 135, in opencast coal workings, the height of benches in overburden/rock shall not exceed:
options: The maximum digging reach of the excavation machine deployed
Twice the width of the bench
The width of the haul road
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 135 dictates bench height shall not exceed the maximum digging reach/height of the shovel/excavator.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Applying organic compost or bio-sludge to leveled overburden dumps during reclamation primary benefits soil by:
options: Enhancing water-retention capacity, soil structure, and microbial activity
questions.solution: Organic amendments supply humus, improve moisture holding capacity, and foster beneficial soil microbial communities.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Buddy System' implemented in high-hazard underground or solitary mining tasks requires:
options: A supervisor monitoring workers via CCTV cameras only
Two workers paired together to continuously monitor each other's safety and well-being
Deploying workers in groups of at least 10 persons
Rotating workers every 2 hours between faces
questions.solution: The buddy system pairs workers so each looks out for the safety of the other, critical in hazardous environments.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In air-deck blasting techniques, introducing an air gap within the explosive column serves to:
options: Reduce overall explosive consumption while achieving uniform stress wave distribution
Eliminate the need for stemming material
Slow down the initiation speed of detonating cord
questions.solution: Air decking allows explosive shockwaves to reverberate inside the void, fracturing rock efficiently with less explosive mass.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: What is the primary operational problem caused by insufficient sub-drilling depth in bench blasting?
options: Hard toe formation (unbroken rock ridges) at the floor level
questions.solution: Sub-drilling ensures the explosive charge sits below floor level; insufficient sub-drilling leaves unbroken floor ridges ('toes').

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 168, electricity must be immediately cut off from a district if the inflammable gas concentration reaches or exceeds:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 168: If methane levels reach 1.25% in any place or return airway, electrical supply to that district must be isolated.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955 Rule 62, rest shelters must be provided at above-ground and opencast mining areas where:
options: More than 50 persons are ordinarily employed
More than 150 persons are ordinarily employed
More than 250 persons are ordinarily employed
More than 10 persons are ordinarily employed
questions.solution: Mines Rules mandate rest shelters in mines where more than 50 persons are ordinarily employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Comprehensive pit dewatering systems in deep opencast mines typically integrate:
options: Main floor sumps, high-head centrifugal pumps, and peripheral ring drainage catch drains
Surface evaporation ponds inside active cuts
Borehole blasting to drain water into underlying strata
Gravity drainage channels without pumping equipment
questions.solution: Effective pit drainage combines peripheral interceptor ditches above the pit with deep sumps and high-capacity pumps.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under DGMS guidelines, the maximum overall slope angle of an overburden waste dump should generally not exceed:
questions.solution: DGMS circulars specify that overall overburden dump slopes must not exceed 28° (approx. 1 in 2) to ensure long-term stability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 129, when a Sirdar completes his shift inspection, his statutory report must be written and signed:
options: Before he leaves the mine at the end of the shift
At the beginning of his next rostered shift
Only at the end of the week
questions.solution: Reg 129 mandates that the Sirdar record and sign his inspection findings before leaving the mine at the end of the shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Electric delay detonators (e.g., Short Delay Detonators) are used in multi-row bench blasting to:
options: Create successive free faces, control fragmentation, and minimize ground vibrations
Increase total shock wave energy generated per charge
Prevent blast smoke from escaping blast holes
Eliminate the need for stemming charges
questions.solution: Delay detonators initiate holes sequentially (milliseconds apart), creating relief faces, reducing vibration overlap, and enhancing fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Crawler-mounted bulldozers are most economically efficient for pushing overburden material over distances up to:
questions.solution: Dozer push operations are economically viable for short haul distances (typically under 100m); beyond this, dumpers/scrapers are preferred.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the mandatory pre-shift inspection of underground working faces and roadways by a Mining Sirdar must begin within:
options: 2 hours before workers enter the district
4 hours before workers enter the district
1 hour after workers enter the district
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 129 stipulates that the pre-shift inspection shall be made within 2 hours prior to workers entering the district.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Heaving' or 'Pushing' action in blasting is primarily governed by which explosive characteristic?
questions.solution: Gas expansion energy (bubble energy) pushes and displaces broken rock after shock waves have micro-fractured the rock mass.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 151, general illumination provided at underground pit bottoms and main junctions must be adequate and supplied from:
options: Individual cap lamps carried by workers
Approved stationary electric lighting systems powered from main distribution lines
Diesel generator lamps placed on locomotives
questions.solution: Reg 151 mandates fixed, permanent electric lighting at key underground locations like shaft bottoms, haulage engine rooms, and junctions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A Safety Climate Survey conducted in coal mines measures:
options: Psychological safety culture, worker perceptions, and management commitment toward safety
Workplace temperature and relative humidity levels
Annual expenditure on safety gear purchase
Ambient air quality parameters around the pit
questions.solution: Safety climate surveys evaluate the shared perceptions and safety attitudes of workforce personnel.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017 Regulation 31, an Overman appointed in a coal mine must hold a valid Overman's Certificate of Competency issued by:
options: The Board of Mining Examinations under DGMS
questions.solution: Competency certificates for Sirdar, Overman, Surveyor, and Managers are granted by the Board of Mining Examinations (DGMS).

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Find the average of the following numbers: 3, 7, 11, and 15.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Where was India's first commercial nuclear power station established?
questions.solution: Tarapur Atomic Power Station (TAPS) in Maharashtra was India's first commercial nuclear power plant, commissioned in 1969.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What is the standard chemical symbol for the metallic element Nickel?
questions.solution: The chemical symbol for Nickel is Ni.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which of the following is the chemical formula for Oxalic Acid?
questions.solution: The molecular formula for oxalic acid is C2H2O4 (or HOOC-COOH).

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Complete the analogy — Book : Author :: Painting : ?
questions.solution: An author creates a book; an artist creates a painting.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The biochemical process involved in converting milk into curd is:
questions.solution: Lactic acid bacteria ferment lactose in milk into lactic acid, forming curd.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which essential human vitamin is chemically known as Retinol?
questions.solution: Retinol is the chemical name for Vitamin A.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who was the first Indian citizen to travel into outer space?
questions.solution: Wing Commander Rakesh Sharma became the first Indian in space aboard Soyuz T-11 in 1984.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who served as the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Constitution Drafting Committee.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who was the first woman to be awarded a Nobel Prize?
questions.solution: Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize (Physics, 1903).

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: In which year was the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) of India established?
questions.solution: NHRC was constituted on 12th October 1993 under the Protection of Human Rights Ordinance.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which word is the correct ANTONYM of 'Cacophony'?
questions.solution: Cacophony means harsh/discordant sound; its opposite is Harmony.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The product of two consecutive positive even numbers is 2880. What are the numbers?
questions.solution: Let numbers be x and (x+2). x(x+2) = 2880 => x² + 2x - 2880 = 0 => (x-50)(x+58) = 0 => x = 50. Numbers are 50 and 52.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: On Mohs Scale of Mineral Hardness, which natural substance scores the highest rating (10)?
questions.solution: Diamond is the hardest naturally occurring mineral, scoring 10 on Mohs scale.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Where is the global headquarters of the International Water Management Institute (IWMI) located?
questions.solution: IWMI headquarters is located in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which planet in our solar system is commonly referred to as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.solution: Mars is called the Red Planet due to prevalent iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
questions.solution: 100 divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 2 (100 = 14 x 7 + 2). Monday + 2 days = Wednesday.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Who is the author of the famous tragedy play 'Hamlet'?
questions.solution: Hamlet was written by William Shakespeare around 1599-1601.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A boat travels 24 km upstream in 6 hours and 24 km downstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.solution: Upstream speed = 24/6 = 4 km/hr. Downstream speed = 24/3 = 8 km/hr. Speed in still water = (4 + 8) / 2 = 6 km/hr.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which non-flammable noble gas is commonly used to inflate weather balloons?
questions.solution: Helium is lightweight and non-flammable, making it ideal for balloons.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Calculate: 25% of 30% of 400 = ?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What is the closest meaning of the vocabulary word 'Loquacious'?
questions.solution: 'Loquacious' means tending to talk a great deal or talkative.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: What is the sum of all interior angles of a convex quadrilateral?
questions.solution: Sum of interior angles = (n - 2) * 180° = (4 - 2) * 180° = 360°.
